positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built automated tools to conduct cold and hot backups on Mongo databases. 
• Created monitoring tools for verifying uptime of databases and services and alerting tools in case of downtime.
• Collaborated on ETL pipelines to maximize throughput, simplify logic, and ingest log data into ELK Stack

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Full-Stack Developer with extensive experience working on web applications and APIs.
•Built out WhatsApp/Facebook messenger features on front-facing websites along with web analytics components for use by clients. 
•Developed aggregate buckets from database info to create new features for front-facing web applications using ElasticSearch.
•Improved search response time on post-back requests by 50% by identifying bottlenecks and optimizing response object.

positions.title: Mentor Assistant
positions.description:
• Train new employees on system use, FCC compliance, and submission of bug reports.
• Act as liaison between corporate management, and new and existing staff. 
• Facilitate communication for hard-of-hearing persons in English and Spanish over telephone.

positions.title: Assistant Language Teacher
positions.description:
• Designed curriculum with team of Japanese teachers for English learners between the ages of 15-18.
• Speech coached the winner of the Hiroshima Prefectural Speech contest in 2014.
• Managed class sizes of 40-120 students.
